content: python-barcode is the correct pure-Python library for Code128/Code39/EAN/UPC 1D barcode generation. Latest version 0.16.1 (confirmed via PyPI JSON API), requires_python>=3.9. SVG output has zero extra deps; PNG output uses Pillow, which enterprise-omni-agent-ai-platform already has pinned (>=12.2.0). Not currently a project dependency -- the one new pip package needed for ITAM asset-tag label generation.
